title: Tamsin and the Harbor Revisited
author: Tamsin Eastwick
blurb: Vesper Nystrom, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
